scope: read-only independent UserInput evidence; no device, build or product edits
important_distinction: Tool UserInput and AsyncQuestionCard are separate official UI/model/routes. Do not combine Tool secret/options metadata with Async pager as one official contract.

tool_user_input.ui: All questions at once; optional header, text, single selected option with label/description. Free text if isOther or zero options. Secret masks visual text. Submit requires all answers nonblank.
tool_user_input.state: Answers map keyed by question ID, remembered using xom request ID. No pager/skip evidenced for this card.
tool_user_input.payload: List<uom(questionID,List<String>(one answer))> in question order -> igk(requestID,answers) -> zsk(requestID,answers) -> fx21.l(host,...). Exact downstream wire/ack lifecycle not traced.

async_question.ui: One question with count, option strings and custom input; UI and Next default to first option when no map entry. Previous skips submitted IDs. Next disabled for blank current effective answer.
async_question.skip: Skips ONLY current question: records empty and removes current pending-submit ID, then advances. At last eligible question, Skip as well as Next submits earlier nonblank pending answers. If none, closes without sending empty aggregate.
async_question.payload: Host path uses pending ID set to filter answer map, then ru81.q emits <send_user_message_question_reply>\n[{questionItemId,question,answer}]\n</send_user_message_question_reply>; trims answer, omits empty/submitted IDs; sent as hwt.M follow-up. This is not Tool zsk RPC.
async_question.identity_busy: s7m host/thread + Async ID; sba requires card ID equals supplied ID and jfy0.s; T false, i true and !k. k submitting suppresses card p. py81.l compares current ID to submitted snapshot before settling, failure clears submitting.
async_question.expiry: anj.l is compared to current time in qu81.a; it is a timestamp/expiry, NOT proven error object.

minimum_reconstruction: Separate typed Tool and Async request variants; no mixed pager-secret card claim.
Tool aggregate answers under exact task/request/question identity with nonblank validation.
Async skip/next/previous and default option behavior above; local aggregation remains separate from actual RPC.
Prevent old response settling replacement using exact scope/request identity; independent adapter revision protections may be added but are not proved original fields.
unknowns: Tool downstream response settlement, busy/error UI replacement and service stale-response rejection are not fully recovered.
Async exact failure message/toast and detailed partial-success replacement policy remain unverified; do not invent inline error UI from anj.l (expiry).
Dedicated MCP elicitation hkk->wy81.h and tvk->t091.d are separate routes; neither recovered as ordinary command approval.
Network/special permission approval UI and real backend grant/reject lifecycle are not restored by generic command buttons or UserInput fields.
Secret UI masking does not prove encryption, non-persistence, clipboard policy or secure transport.
Official full wire protocol/remote backend is not validated; implementation should clearly remain independent typed adapter.
